newsitem.title: USA: Eagle USA in pact with pharmaceutical dist.
newsitem.headline: Eagle USA in pact with pharmaceutical dist.

text.p: Freight forwarder Eagle USA Airfreight said it has formed an alliance with Distribution Solutions, Inc (DSI) to support order fulfillment programs of pharmaceutical companies in the U.S. and Puerto Rico.
DSI is a logistics management company specializing in order fulfillment management for serveral industries.

Eagle USA said it will be DSI's primary carrier for most of the latter's pharmaceutical accounts. Eagle USA also will provide warehouse facilities in 56 domestic locations and electronic data services. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
